scope: Independent test-only regressions for offline native asset search
command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts:tests python -m unittest -v test_asset_library_search_typed_sources
observations: An integer triangle measurement of 1 qualified for budget 1. A registered boolean true did not qualify. Original source and derived bytes remained unchanged on the successful control read.

After a type-only change in the disposable index row from 1 to true, public search completed instead of raising LIBRARY_SEARCH_INDEX. Explicit rebuild recovered the original hit, and all original bytes remained intact.

Under a temporary native SQLite EXCLUSIVE transaction without source edits, a pinned rebuild returned success instead of LIBRARY_STORAGE, changed the prior index and left the search stale after lock release. Native source bytes remained intact.

A checked-in rig document with neutral search metadata and a prop with both lexical decoys were registered. Structured controls returned the correct exact kinds. Singular and plural natural-language queries returned the prop. Source and index bytes remained intact.
limitations: This run exercises local registered fixtures and a disposable search index. Rig runtime readiness, real embeddings, external providers, licensing and release approval remain unverified.
An amended candidate requires independent exact-head review and CI. This test-only change adds no gate configuration.
